commander.oracle_text:
Ward {2}
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
The top card of your library has plot. The plot cost is equal to its mana cost.
You may plot nonland cards from the top of your library.

themes.name: Top-Deck Roundup
themes.pitch: Peek at your library, plot the best top card for free, and cast a stream of spells from exile.

themes.name: Ward 2 and a Dream
themes.pitch: Suit up a tiny, warded wanderer with gear and evasion, and make it a real threat.

themes.name: Found: One Legend
themes.pitch: Fill the deck with legends and homunculi, then copy or cast the best of them from the top of your library.

themes.name: Plotting the Perfect Cantrip
themes.pitch: Plot instants and sorceries off the top, then chain them together and copy the best ones.

themes.name: Now You See Fblthp
themes.pitch: Plot enter-the-battlefield creatures for free, then blink and clone them for repeated value.

themes.name: Scrap Heap Wanderer
themes.pitch: Plot artifacts off the top and pay nothing extra, turning cast-for-free steel into a mechanical menagerie.
